question: to the Commission Özlem Demirel (The Left) Subject:

Europol has established a Network of Experts on Handling Informants on its Platform for Experts (EPE). This network deals with the management of undercover agents – known as CHIS (Covert Human Intelligence Sources): individuals outside law enforcement agencies who act as confidential contacts. Europol maintains a register of the persons responsible for CHIS management in each Member State. In operations supported by Europol, including those under the Eastern Partnership programme, costs relating to the deployment of CHIS may be declared as eligible expenditure. 1.
In how many joint investigation teams or comparable operations supported by Europol were informants (CHIS) deployed per year in 2023, 2024 and 2025?
Which EU Member States and third countries were involved in each of these operations, and from which countries did the informants originate?
What definition of ‘informant’ or ‘CHIS’ forms the basis of Europol’s funding guidelines?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (27.4.2026)

The Commission has asked the European Union Agency for Law Enforcement Cooperation (Europol) to provide a reply to the question put forward by the Honourable Member. The reply of the agency will be transmitted by the Commission to the Honourable Member as soon as possible.
